bundle: Kokoro-82M v1.0 'Fable-mix' (en_GB-fablemix) for ONNX Runtime on CPU

files.name: kokoro-v1.0.onnx
files.notes: fp32 ONNX export of hexgrad/Kokoro-82M v1.0 (onnx-community, pinned commit). Saved under this name. Do not substitute the fp16 (NaN audio on CPU) or int8 (changed timing) files from the same repository.

files.name: config.json
files.notes: Kokoro-82M's own config; the backend reads only its phoneme vocabulary.

files.name: en_GB-fablemix.npy
files.notes: The voice-scout Fable-mix pack (voice-scout/voices/kokoro-fablemix.pt, sha256 cadc5c98dc83ac96214afbdb8952ddb0edc88ccfd95adbdb97ea96ca332e6d79) saved as a plain float32 NumPy array [510, 1, 256], bit-identical values, no pickle. Rebuild and check with tools/convert_voice.py.

files.name: en_GB-fablemix-short.npy
files.notes: Short-reply pack: Fable-mix timbre half, prosody half 50 % bm_fable + 50 % the inno-kokoro fitted pack that Fable-mix itself contains. Used for pieces under 60 phonemes (fully under 40). Built by tools/convert_voice.py.
